item.title: Detroit Trip
item.description:
I don’t have much for this week. I took some time to attend a few nights hearing Kevin Zadai speak in Detroit. It was Wednesday through Friday. I was able to attend Thursday and Friday nights.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gnMZe-_Clkg - Wednesday

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JEaBoLuEIkQ - Friday

It was great best vacation I had in years. Felt much healing and came home with a ton of books to read. Went to Discount Bible book and music store.
